input.prompt: Ultra-realistic cinematic film still, shot on ARRI Alexa 35mm, vertical 9:16 frame. Camera placed BEHIND a grey fabric three-seat sofa, low and static, looking across a dark middle-class Brazilian apartment living room at night toward a large wall-mounted flat-screen TV (switched off, glossy black screen reflecting a lamp) above a wooden TV rack with a plant, a ceramic vase and a few books. The back of the sofa fills the lower third of the frame. Lights off; the only light is a warm table lamp with a fabric shade in the far left corner casting soft diffuse amber light, plus faint cool blue city light through sheer curtains. White walls, a framed print, patterned rug, ceramic tile floor. Nobody in the room. Deep shadows, natural film grain, realistic textures, no text, no logos.
